name: DokanLens AI

model_candidates.name: Tesseract OCR with ben+eng language packs
model_candidates.must_smoke_test: Extract Bangla digits/Latin amounts from owned sample image; low-confidence flag

model_candidates.name: torchvision pretrained MobileNetV3/EfficientNet-B0 feature backbone
model_candidates.license_observed: Check torchvision library license and selected checkpoint weight terms
model_candidates.must_smoke_test: Two local licensed/test images produce finite embeddings and predictable nearest-neighbor ID

model_candidates.name: sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
model_candidates.must_smoke_test: Encode two real Bengali strings and assert different finite vectors; search should return expected source ID

model_candidates.name: scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingRegressor / RandomForestRegressor
model_candidates.must_smoke_test: Dataset has sufficient lawful historical rows; fit/test with MAE vs naive baseline, no leakage

evaluation: Top-1/top-5 on consented locally labeled product photos; barcode exact match

hard_safety_limit: No real stock counts from single photo without confirmed stock ledger
simple_user_flow: shelf photo/barcode > confirm items > stock actions
advanced_features: purchase ledger, expiry tracker, reorder forecasting
